title: Disability Compensation and Veterans Pension: Same-Month Exclusion and Election
content:
Disability Compensation and Veterans Pension are never paid to the same veteran for the same month.

A veteran with a running Veterans Pension award who is granted compensation receives whichever benefit is greater unless they elect otherwise in writing. When compensation is greater, the pension award is terminated by election effective the last day of the month before compensation becomes payable, and compensation is paid from that month. A veteran who elects pension over a greater compensation award has the compensation award terminated with the reason "election of pension".

An election is the veteran's own decision and is never made for them on a call.

**Outcomes at a glance**

| Comparison | Written election by the veteran | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Compensation greater | None | Pension terminated by election the last day of the month before compensation becomes payable; compensation paid from that month |
| Compensation greater | Elects pension | Compensation award terminated, reason "election of pension" |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** Compensation becomes payable for the month of August and is the greater benefit. The Veterans Pension award is terminated by election effective 31 July, and Disability Compensation is paid from August; no month is paid under both.
